note: Teaching definitions for a fictional retailer. Not any real company's accounting policy.

metrics.name: units_sold
metrics.description: Units on order items placed in the month, excluding cancelled orders.
metrics.formula: count of units on non-cancelled order items placed in the month
assumptions: An order cancelled before shipping is not a sale.

metrics.name: gross_sales
metrics.description: Sales at list price before any discount or refund.
metrics.formula: sum(quantity x list_price) for non-cancelled order items placed in the month
assumptions: An order cancelled before shipping is not a sale.

metrics.name: discounts
metrics.description: Discounts given on the month's order items.
metrics.formula: sum(discount) on the order items counted in gross_sales

metrics.name: refunds
metrics.description: Refunds issued to customers in the month.
metrics.formula: sum(refund_amount) for refunds issued in the month
assumptions: A refund counts in the month it is issued, not the month of the original order.

metrics.name: net_sales
metrics.description: What customers paid for products in the month, after discounts, less refunds issued in the month.
assumptions: A refund counts in the month it is issued, not the month of the original order.
If any component is missing, the result is missing. Nothing is estimated or treated as zero.

metrics.name: product_cost
metrics.description: What the retailer paid its vendors for the units sold.
assumptions: Returned units are not resaleable, so product cost is not reduced by returns.
If any component is missing, the result is missing. Nothing is estimated or treated as zero.

metrics.name: gross_profit
metrics.description: Net sales less the cost of the products sold.
assumptions: If any component is missing, the result is missing. Nothing is estimated or treated as zero.

metrics.name: fulfillment_cost
metrics.description: Pick-and-pack cost for orders shipped in the month.
metrics.formula: sum(pick_and_pack_cost) for orders shipped in the month

metrics.name: shipping_cost
metrics.description: Carrier cost for orders shipped in the month.
metrics.formula: sum(carrier_cost) for orders shipped in the month

metrics.name: payment_fees
metrics.description: Payment provider fees on payments captured in the month.
metrics.formula: sum(payment_fee) for payments captured in the month

metrics.name: return_cost
metrics.description: Cost of handling returns for refunds issued in the month.
metrics.formula: sum(return_handling_cost) for refunds issued in the month

metrics.name: contribution_profit
metrics.description: Gross profit less the costs that rise with each order: fulfilment, shipping, payment fees, and handling returns.
assumptions: Fixed costs such as salaries, rent, and marketing are not included.
If any component is missing, the result is missing. Nothing is estimated or treated as zero.
